scenes.text: If someone stole your wallet key tonight, what could they actually take? On QoreChain, only what your post-quantum key left open. Fenestella shows you that opening, shrinks it, and lets an AI agent work inside it without ever being able to rob you.

scenes.title: Live, not a mock-up
scenes.text: Everything here is live. The home page reads the chain while you watch: attacks refused, the agent's latest payments, and test counts taken straight from the real runs.

scenes.title: See the truth
scenes.text: Paste any address. In one sentence, Fenestella tells you what a leaked classical key could do right now. This account is sealed: post-quantum key registered, no window open. So the answer is nothing.

scenes.title: Open a fenestella
scenes.text: Connect a wallet, and open a window cut down to one contract, a few transactions and a small cap. Your post-quantum key signs it, the chain enforces every bound, and one click closes it again.

scenes.title: An agent on a leash
scenes.text: Now the agent. Its key is linked with one permission: call one function of your vault. The money lives in that vault, and only your post-quantum signature can approve a payee or set the limits.

scenes.title: The AI reads the bill
scenes.text: A phishing invoice arrives: new wallet, pay now. The AI checks the chain with its own tools, finds nothing to match, and refuses. The genuine invoice matches a real bill, so it drafts the payment.

scenes.title: Sealed, signed, paid
scenes.text: You seal the order to the agent, and sign its fingerprint with your post-quantum key. The agent proves it came from you, asks its AI for a second opinion, and pays from the vault.

scenes.title: It runs on its own
scenes.text: Or sign one standing permission, and it pays that payee by itself, inside your limits. After every payment it reports back, signed with its own post-quantum key and sealed so only you can read it.

scenes.title: One red button
scenes.text: And if the agent's key ever leaks? One red button. A single signed transaction revokes the agent and freezes the vault. Nothing has to move, and the agent's whole record stays on the page, with receipts.

scenes.title: Try to rob it
scenes.text: Now play the thief. The attack lab throws thirteen real attacks at it: stolen keys, forged signatures, phishing, prompt injection. Every one is refused. And every attempt anyone makes is published, failures and all.

scenes.title: The whole chain
scenes.text: The radar reads every account on QoreChain every six hours, and shows how many a quantum attacker could take today. Totals only, never an address. And one click seals yours.

scenes.title: Your own AI agent
scenes.text: Any AI app can run the agent too. One command, and Claude can check accounts, ask you for a window, and pay approved bills, while the chain still refuses everything else.
Every result you saw is a real testnet transaction, backed by a threat model, two audits and the tests to prove it. Fenestella. See how far your key reaches, and keep it small.
